name: Setting an image as primary moves the Primary badge (Pixel 7a — seeded 3 images)

preconditions.note: Pixel 7a variant c2b09ec4-... was seeded with 3 variant_images (1 primary + 2 non-primary)

steps.description: Open the Pixel 7a admin variant detail (seeded with 3 images)

steps.script: (() => { const tiles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("img[alt='Variant image']")).map(img => img.closest('div.relative')); const primaryTile = tiles.find(t => t && !!t.querySelector('p-tag .p-tag-value, .p-tag-value')?.textContent?.toLowerCase()?.includes('primary')) || tiles.find(t => t && /Primary/i.test(t.textContent || '')); const primarySrc = primaryTile?.querySelector('img')?.src || ''; return { primarySrc, totalTiles: tiles.length }; })()

(() => { const tiles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("img[alt='Variant image']")).map(img => img.closest('div.relative')); for (const tile of tiles) { if (!tile) continue; const hasPrimaryBadge = /Primary/i.test(tile.textContent || ''); if (hasPrimaryBadge) continue; const starBtn = tile.querySelector('button .pi-star')?.closest('button'); if (starBtn) { starBtn.click(); return { clicked: true, tileSrc: tile.querySelector('img')?.src || '' }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: Click 'Set as primary' button on a non-primary image

steps.script: (() => { const tiles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("img[alt='Variant image']")).map(img => img.closest('div.relative')); const primaryTiles = tiles.filter(t => t && /Primary/i.test(t.textContent || '')); return { primaryCount: primaryTiles.length, primarySrcAfter: primaryTiles[0]?.querySelector('img')?.src || '' }; })()
steps.description: Exactly one image has the Primary badge after the toggle

businessContext: Primary image is what appears on the catalog card — wrong primary means wrong first impression. The Pixel 7a variant has 3 seeded images so the toggle can be exercised reliably.
